newsitem.title: UK: Compass to buy U.S. firm Daka for $195 mln.
newsitem.headline: Compass to buy U.S. firm Daka for $195 mln.

text.p: British food service mamangement group Compass Group Plc said on Wednesday that its U.S. unit is making a $195 million cash offer for U.S. foodservice company Daka International Inc.
Daka, which operates 710 accounts in 34 U.S. states, said in May it was close to announcing a decision on "strategic alternatives" it has been considering.
Mike Bailey, chief executive of Compass Group USA division, said the acquisition would "enable Compass Group to build on its position as a leading foodservice provider in the U.S. education market."
Compass said the sector was estimated to be worth some $21 billion a year.
